title: 模拟 PITR：操作日志重放到目标时间点（丢弃越界语句）
expected_output:
=== 模拟 PITR: 全量备份 + 操作日志重放到目标时间点 ===
全量备份点状态 = [(1, 'alice', 1000), (2, 'bob', 500), (3, 'carol', 200)]
目标恢复点 TARGET = 2026-10-09T10:20:00
重放(已应用)语句条数 = 3
跳过(在 TARGET 之后)语句条数 = 2
  跳过: 2026-10-09T10:30:00 -> DELETE FROM accounts
  跳过: 2026-10-09T10:31:00 -> UPDATE accounts SET balance=0 WHERE id=2
重放到 TARGET 后的表状态 = [(1, 'alice', 800), (2, 'bob', 700), (3, 'carol', 200), (4, 'dave', 300)]
误删操作已被回滚(表非空) = True
[对照] 若不裁剪时间点、一路重放到底: 表状态 = []
[对照] 行数 = 0
结论: PITR = 恢复全量备份 + 重放 [备份点, TARGET] 区间的日志，越界语句必须丢弃
code:
import sqlite3

DDL = "CREATE TABLE accounts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, balance INT NOT NULL);"
BASE = [(1, "alice", 1000), (2, "bob", 500), (3, "carol", 200)]

# 操作日志（模拟 binlog 里的行级事件；ts 为逻辑时钟）
OPS = [
    ("2026-10-09T10:00:00", "UPDATE accounts SET balance=balance-200 WHERE id=1", ()),
    ("2026-10-09T10:01:00", "UPDATE accounts SET balance=balance+200 WHERE id=2", ()),
    ("2026-10-09T10:05:00", "INSERT INTO accounts(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", (4, "dave", 300)),
    ("2026-10-09T10:30:00", "DELETE FROM accounts", ()),
    ("2026-10-09T10:31:00", "UPDATE accounts SET balance=0 WHERE id=2", ()),
]
TARGET = "2026-10-09T10:20:00"   # 目标恢复点：误删之前


def snapshot():
    con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    con.execute(DDL)
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO accounts(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", BASE)
    return con


def state(con):
    return con.execute("SELECT id,owner,balance FROM accounts ORDER BY id").fetchall()


def replay(con, upto):
    applied, skipped = 0, []
    for ts, sql, params in OPS:
        if upto is not None and ts > upto:
            skipped.append((ts, sql))
            continue
        con.execute(sql, params)
        applied += 1
    return applied, skipped


print("=== 模拟 PITR: 全量备份 + 操作日志重放到目标时间点 ===")
con = snapshot()
print("全量备份点状态 =", state(con))
print("目标恢复点 TARGET =", TARGET)

applied, skipped = replay(con, TARGET)
print("重放(已应用)语句条数 =", applied)
print("跳过(在 TARGET 之后)语句条数 =", len(skipped))
for ts, sql in skipped:
    print("  跳过:", ts, "->", sql)
print("重放到 TARGET 后的表状态 =", state(con))
print("误删操作已被回滚(表非空) =", len(state(con)) > 0)

bad = snapshot()
replay(bad, None)
print("[对照] 若不裁剪时间点、一路重放到底: 表状态 =", state(bad))
print("[对照] 行数 =", len(state(bad)))
print("结论: PITR = 恢复全量备份 + 重放 [备份点, TARGET] 区间的日志，越界语句必须丢弃")
